  "hypothesis": "Predicted that auditory flankers would facilitate the processing of visual targets when their letter names are identical (perceptual-congruent), but would not produce response-congruent facilitation compared to incongruent trials.",
  "design": "within",
  "manipulation_or_predictor": "Congruency condition (perceptual-congruent, response-congruent, or response-incongruent) where auditory flankers and visual targets were either identical, shared a response, or were associated with different responses.",
  "outcome_measure": "Reaction time (RT) and percentage of correct responses (PC).",
  "population_and_setting": "36 participants recruited from the University of Tübingen, tested in a noise-shielded cabin.",
  "sample_size_total": 36,
  "recruitment_and_incentive": "University students; received course credits.",
  "analysis_plan": "One-way ANOVA comparing RT and PC across the three congruency conditions.",
  "preregistered_or_confirmatory": "not stated",
  "other_methods_notes": "The visual target appeared 500 ms after the onset of the auditory flanker. Two letters were assigned to one response and two to the other. Trials with RTs outside 150-1500 ms were excluded."
